Patient context
Which side is being evaluated?
Research mode: use a de-identified Case ID only. Do not enter patient names or medical record numbers.
Laterality is recorded for the report but does not alter the superior/inferior decision tree.
Isthmus relationship
Is the lesion's largest cross-section higher than the superior border of the thyroid isthmus?
isthmus_IS_ratio > 1
Carotid relationship
Is the lesion centroid anterior to the anterior wall of the common carotid artery?
carotid_AP_ratio > 1
Posterior-inferior relationship
Is the lesion's largest cross-section below the inferior border of the thyroid isthmus AND is its centroid posterior to the posterior wall of the CCA?
carotid < 0 AND isthmus < 0
Sagittal branch
In sagittal view, is the angle between the parathyroid long axis and the cranial side greater than 90°?
a2d_sagittal_pc1_fixP_toS > 90°
3D shape branch
Is the lesion's 3D longest-axis / shortest-axis ratio greater than 2.5?
shape3d_pc1_pc3 > 2.5

    Google Sheets

    Choose the workflow that fits your study setup.

    1
    Fastest: Copy one row

    Copies headers + the current case as tab-separated values. Open Google Sheets and paste into cell A1.

    2
    Import file

    Export the case as CSV, then use File → Import in Google Sheets. The Excel file exported by ParaNav can also be uploaded directly to Google Drive and opened with Google Sheets.

    3
    Direct append (optional)

    For a research registry, deploy a Google Apps Script Web App and paste its URL below. ParaNav will append the current record to your Sheet.
